about_the_game:
The Official Game Soundtrack brings extra flavor and immersion to your Ara: History Untold experience.

This complete soundtrack includes over 100 original compositions with hours of music that evolves over time, spanning The Ancient Era to The Future Age, and is available in a wide variety of formats including High Quality Stereo MP3.

Also included is a Digital Art Book packed full of inspirational artwork created during the development process of the game.
